definition: [ סְעִפָּה ] noun feminine division, divided opinion ; — plural absolute עַלשְֿׁתֵּי הַסְּעִפִּים 1Kgs 18:21 how long are ye limping on the two divided opinions (as on unequal legs; ᵐ5 ταῖς ἰγνύαις seems an attempt to interpret the figurative; according to Albr ZAW xvi (1896) 75 {abbrev } ס really = legs ).
